projects.description: An open-source coding agent that runs on your iPhone — reads, edits, tests and commits code on-device. No laptop, no server, no account.
evidence: 2 GitHub stars and 0 forks. These can be manipulated and are not proof of quality.
GitHub topics: ai-agent, anthropic, byok, coding-agent, git, ios.

opportunity.reason: The repository declares early development and lists concrete unfinished work.

stage.text: > ⚠️ Pokeet is in early development. We're building it in public — [join the TestFlight beta](https://testflight.apple.com/join/VZcpybTc) and tell us what breaks.

tasks.title: **v1 — built, in TestFlight.** Agent loop with four review modes, workspace, git (clone/diff/commit/push over HTTPS with a personal access token), diff review, guarded HTTP tool, web search, sandboxed `run_script` for Ja

**v2 — next.** CPython is embedded and `run_script` already runs it; the missing piece is an audit-hook sandbox, so a Python project's own test suite can run on the device. For the handful of things a phone genuinely can

factors.label: Source quality
factors.detail: License listed; README present; source present; tests present; CI present. Complete file listing checked. File presence does not prove working software or security.

factors.label: Active development
factors.detail: Fresh GitHub metadata and code pushed within 30 days. Activity in the last two days receives full credit; older activity decays.

factors.label: Adoption
factors.detail: Capped, logarithmic stars and forks. This measures repository adoption, not current virality. Popularity alone cannot earn an 80+ score.

factors.label: Demo & theme
factors.detail: Characters that think and do. Theme matching is based on repository metadata, not measured virality. An actual project demo is available.

factors.label: GitHub momentum
factors.detail: No fresh Trending placement or measured growth. Total stars do not earn momentum points.

factors.label: Social traction
factors.detail: Fresh, directly linked X posts: measured reach, distinct authors, recency and engagement. Missing views earn no points and are shown as unknown. Audiences are never added together.
